coverage.where: year, m01, w01, d0115 (PDF link check)
coverage.note: Monday-start grids; PDF check: year links all 365 days, each month links its weeks, all 52 weeks link their 2027 days, every day page links previous and next (0 broken links).
November and December 2026 month pages, 10 head start weeks from Oct 26 and 67 day pages; Oct 26-31 sit in the November grid and in hsw01 (no October month page).
One 533-page landscape PDF (768x576 pt), plain link annotations only; listing names Goodnotes first plus Notability, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes, Xodo. Not tested inside the apps.

coverage.where: year, goals, m01, m07, m01h (rendered), w01, d0115, notes
coverage.note: Year at a glance, 2027 goals, 12 months, habit tracker per month (m01h-m12h, January rendered and checked), 52 weeks, 365 days, 6 notes pages.
Deep navy pages; embedded fonts are Libre Baskerville (bold, italic) and Outfit only; consistent spacing; tabs run periwinkle (Jan) to amber (Dec).
Start here (4 steps incl. Choose a light pen), Setup check page, and a How the links work box on Contents.
One 13.49 MB PDF, no zip; listing and photo 9 give Download in a browser (not the Etsy app), Open via Share then Open in Goodnotes, Start; Start here step 1 repeats it.
Open planner links to Start here (4 steps, jump grid Nov 2026 to Dec 2027); Setup check has 3 jump buttons and a pen test box; no stickers or add-ons.
Pages are 4:3 landscape (768x576 pt = 1024x768 px); all links are plain PDF links; Works with / Not made for phones, e-ink, Files, Photos, Google Drive preview is in the listing.
Every day page has the same boxes (Top 3, Work, Home left; Time blocks 6am-10pm and Tomorrow right: five boxes, not six); weeks identical; Home/Year/Goals/Notes bar on every page except the cover.

Tabs on every page; ISO weeks verified (Week 1 = Jan 4, 2027); 2027 cross-month weeks sit under their Thursday month; day trails link month and week; hsw10 (Dec 28-Jan 3) is the last head start week. hsw01 (Thu Oct 29) sits under November.

Photos 1-8 are captioned screenshots of the file (photo 9 is a How it works card); description lists every page type with correct counts and dark only, landscape, Monday start, no stickers, handwrite/text tool, English only. It says dated to January 2, 2028, not December 31, 2027.
Three jump buttons, pen test box and four-line Nothing happened? list; 11878 links all resolve and all 533 pages are reachable from the cover.
Fix list in file; Quick answers FAQ covers all five problems; Help says Setup check, then send the shop an Etsy message; no reply-time promise anywhere (r007 ok).
Work/Home days and focus weeks shown in photos 2-3; description says no stickers, budget, meal or fitness sections and no light version. Pages are shown whole rather than close up (see visual).

Oct 26, 2026 to Week 52 (ends Jan 2, 2028), a page per day; half of each day page is time blocks and Tomorrow; lined day boxes on weeks. Photo 2 shows the day page about 1.6x its 1024 px size at full resolution, but as the whole page, not a close-up.
Background measured #1B1F2B, main text #EEEAF4 (about 15:1); amber in tabs and the active tab; Start here step 3 says pick white or a pale pen.
Day: Top 3, Work, Home left, Time blocks 6am-10pm and Tomorrow right; week: This week's focus, Wins, Next week.
Buttons to a month (Jan 2027), The year and Contents, all verified in the PDF; pen test box; Nothing happened? fix list.

Navy/light/amber, two families and periwinkle-to-amber tabs are right, but 'everything well above 7 to 1' fails: tab labels about 4.9-6:1, Contents month tiles 6.7:1, italic card labels 6.2:1, greyed dates 3:1.

visual.issue: r013 not really fixed: photos 2-6 and 8 all use the same near-whole-page crop (x 3-94.5%, y 6-97.4%) shrunk into about 55% of the photo width, with empty bands above and below; small text (time block hours, Start here step text, fix list) is tiny at Etsy's normal view. Crop to the useful part and fill the frame.
Photo 7 puts two whole pages side by side: year mini-calendar dates and the How the links work text are too small to read even at full zoom.

End date disagrees: the listing says dated to January 2, 2028 (and the brief said December 31, 2027), the cover says to December 2027, and Jan 1-2, 2028 appear only as greyed, unlinked boxes on Week 52 with no day pages (r003).
Photo 7 point 'Contents and month tabs' names the month tabs, but the crop cuts them out (r013: points describe only what is in frame).
Contrast is below the brief's 7:1 in places: month tab labels about 4.9:1 (Jan) to 6:1 (Dec), Contents month tiles 6.7:1, italic labels on cards 6.2:1, greyed dates 3:1.
hsw01 (Oct 26-Nov 1, Thursday Oct 29) is built under November 2026 with a November trail, against r008. There is no October page, so it works for buyers, but it breaks the rule as written.
On the cover, Contents, Start here and all 2027 pages the Nov and Dec tabs open November and December 2027; a head start buyer who taps Nov on the cover lands a year ahead.
Photo 9 step 3 says to tap Open planner, then today's date, but Open planner opens Start here, where a month must be tapped first.
Setup check left column ends about 260 px above the page bottom, leaving an empty band under the fix list.
The swash J in 'January' headings hangs past the left margin used by everything else.
The Habit trackers card on Contents always opens January's tracker; a mid-year buyer has to go through a month page to reach the current one.
